title: Inducing Group Fairness in Prompt-Based Language Model Decisions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Equal Opportunity (EO) fairness by measuring the False Positive Rate (FPR) ratio of a toxicity classifier on comments referencing religious groups (e.g., Muslim, Jewish, Hindu, Buddhist) using the Civil Comments Identity dataset.

Evaluating Equal Opportunity (EO) fairness by measuring the False Positive Rate (FPR) ratio of a toxicity classifier on comments referencing racial and ethnic groups (e.g., Black, Asian, Latino) using the Civil Comments Identity dataset.

Evaluating Equal Opportunity (EO) fairness by measuring the False Positive Rate (FPR) ratio of a toxicity classifier on comments referencing gender identities (e.g., female, transgender, other gender) using the Civil Comments Identity dataset.

Evaluating Equal Opportunity (EO) fairness by measuring the False Positive Rate (FPR) ratio of a toxicity classifier on comments referencing sexual orientations (e.g., homosexual, bisexual) using the Civil Comments Identity dataset.
